selection: First row-major full-support grid patch in each fixed raw prior-DA3 disagreement band; no RGB score, GT, or LC outcome is read. Prior hole requires all 81 prior pixels invalid and all DA3 pixels valid. Independently add first prior/DA3-full patch with MVS count<81; this does not change earlier category selections.
neighbor_selection: Train membership only; center distance ascending, camera name tie-break; nonzero baseline and optical-axis angle only. No photometric or projected-support selection.

pixel_conventions.reference_rgb_and_da3: Integer raster centers (u,v), current RGB/GS adapter convention.
pixel_conventions.prior: Open3D samples lie at (u+0.5,v+0.5); query prior array at (u-0.5,v-0.5), bilinear only when all four source samples are finite positive. Diagnostic alignment only; sealed training targets unchanged.
pixel_conventions.mvs: Map common integer reference ray through native K; nearest native sample, floor(coord+0.5); preserve native holes. Recorded-version COLMAP source supports integer centers; historical producer image is unavailable, so exact producer binary and half-pixel sensitivity remain unverified. No generated or filled target.
pixel_conventions.neighbor_rgb: Project world point with original neighbor K/R/t, then bilinear RGB at resulting integer-center coordinates.

score: Gray=0.299R+0.587G+0.114B on [0,1]; population means/std on pairwise common valid 9x9 pixels; ZNCC=mean(zref*zwarp), cost=(1-ZNCC)/2. No support/texture/photo quality gate beyond mathematical undefined cases.
